newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Pacific BBA buys out Malaysian plastics.
newsitem.headline: Pacific BBA buys out Malaysian plastics.

text.p: Pacific BBA Ltd said on Thursday it has acquired the 49 percent share in its local plastics business, Yuta Viscount Sdn, previously owned by local interests.
Yuta Viscount, which makes plastic pails and cartridges for the paint, chemical and building supplies industries, was acquired in 1991 as a joint venture between Pacific BBA and two local businesses.

Pacific BBA managing director Barry Jackson said Malaysian law requires foreign companies to have local joint venture partners, but the company had received approval to buy out its partners and had been allowed two years to find a new partner.
"Yuta Viscount, although small, is a key plastics business in our Asian network," Jackson said in a statement, addding that Pacific BBA intended to grow the business.
Pacific BBA last month bought out the minority partner in its Malaysian automotive business.
